function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The finding that `arm` and `severity` are strongly associated indicates confounding. Since the treatment was not randomised and clinicians preferentially assigned treatment to sicker patients, severity is a confounder of the treatment-response relationship. A raw difference in response rates between arms would be biased. To obtain an unbiased estimate of the treatment effect, we must adjust for severity by stratifying the analysis. We will compute the response rate difference within each severity stratum (mild, moderate, severe), then combine them using standardisation (using the distribution of severity in the overall population as weights). This gives a marginal treatment effect that adjusts for confounding."}
function.name: resolve_finding
